name: energy-ball
description: Rasengan-style energy orb on the speaker's hand: swirling core, spiral bands, wind rings and sparks spiralling out; enters with a flash and shockwave, implodes at the end.

params.x: optional px position when there is no hand track (else gesture place, else centre)
params.y: optional px position when there is no hand track

name: stat-card
description: One big number that counts up: on a card with a highlighter sweep, a label and an optional note (optional darkened screenshot behind), or as a hero number filling the panel. Takes the theme's panel colour and fonts.

params.value: the number (counts up from 0; decimals kept)
params.prefix: optional text before the number, e.g. "$"
params.suffix: optional text after the number, e.g. "%" or " mln"
params.label: what the number means (short sentence)
params.media: optional screenshot shown darkened behind the card
params.layout: "card" (default: the number on a card) or "hero" (the number fills the panel, no card, label under it)

name: flow
description: Step-by-step diagram: 2-6 numbered boxes pop in one by one and arrows draw between them (clean cards or hand-drawn Rough.js).

name: ui-mock
description: Mock window in the theme's look: an AI chat, a terminal session or a social post whose text types in, a browser page (address bar, typed search, result rows, one row circled) or an app screen (typed filter, rows with toggles that a cursor clicks on). Browser / app actions are spaced evenly over the span: type search, rows in, clicks / circle.

params.lines: chat / terminal / post: [{"who": "user"|"ai"|"cmd", "text": "..."}, ...] (terminal: user/cmd typed after $, ai printed as output)
params.title: optional window / account name; browser: page heading; app: screen title (e.g. "Connectors")
params.url: browser: the address shown in the address bar (domain bold, path muted)
params.search: browser / app, optional: text typed into the page search / filter field (first action)
params.rows: browser / app: up to 8 [{"text", "sub"?, "badge"?}] (app also "toggle"?: true|false = the switch's final state, "click"?: true = the cursor clicks the row and its switch flips to that state); they appear one by one after the search
params.highlight: browser, optional: row index circled in the accent colour at the end
params.replies: post only, optional: real reply count (number counts up; text shown as is); absent = not shown
params.reposts: post only, optional: real repost count; absent = not shown
params.likes: post only, optional: real like count; absent = not shown (no counters at all when none is given)

name: iso-machine
description: Isometric 3D machine (product-diagram style): 2-5 parts drop in and assemble on a conveyor, gears turn, a press stamps, tokens index through station by station, numbered labels point at the parts, optional output counter.

params.parts: 2-5 items {"label", "shape": "box"|"cylinder"|"funnel"|"screen"|"gear", "color"?} in process order (box = housing, cylinder = piston press, funnel = hopper, screen = monitor + scanner, gear = gearbox)
params.token: optional "cube" or "sphere": items travelling through the parts on the conveyor
params.counter: optional {"to": number, "label": "..."}: an output crate whose number counts up as tokens land in it
params.title: optional heading above the machine
params.theme: "light" (default), "dark" or "panel" (the theme's --panel-bg, cards and ink; light or dark follows the panel colour)
params.accent: optional accent colour for tokens / crate / screen (default theme --accent)

name: checklist
description: Status table in the theme's look (e.g. a link check): 2-8 rows tick in one by one, each status pill resolves from "···" to OK / ERROR / WARNING / INFO (or your own label like "200 OK", "404", "OUTDATED"); bad rows can be struck through; optional big number beside the table that counts up.

params.title: optional heading of the table (e.g. "Link check")
params.rows: 2-8 [{"text", "status": "ok"|"bad"|"warn"|"info", "label"?}] in order (default labels pl: OK / BŁĄD / UWAGA / INFO, en: OK / ERROR / WARNING / INFO; label overrides)
params.strike: optional true: bad rows are struck through after their status lands
params.summary: optional {"value": number, "suffix"?, "label"?}: a big number beside the table, counting up while the rows land (e.g. {"value": 50, "suffix": "%", "label": "failed"})

name: headline
description: The sentence's key phrase in big display type on the panel (filler for a sentence with no number, product or steps): typed letter by letter with a block caret, or words popping in; optional kicker label above.

params.mode: "type" (default: typed with a block caret) or "pop" (words pop in one by one)

name: showcase-3d
description: Hero 3D object beside the speaker: flies in on a curve from off-screen, turns slowly and flies out. Glossy clearcoat material under studio light (key, two coloured rims, reflections), rim glow, halo and floating dust. Shapes: torus knot, faceted gem, 3D text or your own GLB model.

params.text: the word for shape "text" (extruded; Polish letters use Droid Sans Bold)
params.model: GLB file for shape "glb": put the graphic-level "media": "broll/<file>.glb" (build copies it), or a file name inside the effect folder (P.assets); falls back to the torus knot if it cannot load
params.color: base colour (default "#7c3aed"); rim lights use its complement
params.size: object size as a fraction of the shorter frame side (default 0.4)
params.x: optional px x of the centre (default: gesture place — on an open palm it rests on the palm and follows it — else the right third)
params.y: optional px y of the centre (default: gesture place, else 45% down)

name: burst
description: One-shot energy impact (~1-1.4 s), big enough to read on a phone: hot white flash with a star flare, three shockwave rings, a lingering coloured glow, 150 streak sparks with drag and gravity, falling embers. Placed on an open palm it rides with the hand.

params.size: reach multiplier (default 1 = 20% of the shorter frame side; 1.2-1.6 for a hero moment)
params.x: optional px x (default: gesture place, else centre)
params.y: optional px y (default: gesture place, else centre)

name: hand-sparks
description: Energy pouring out of the speaker's hands: a glow on each palm and a stream of particles leaving it, following the hands. mode stream = soft motes flowing outward and up (spread hands, presenting); mode sparks = hot streak sparks falling with gravity (a trick, a fast move); link = a flickering energy arc between the two hands.

params.size: scale of the glow, particle count and speed (default 1)
params.link: true: energy arc between the two hands while both are in view
params.x: optional px x when there is no hand (else gesture place, else centre)
params.y: optional px y when there is no hand
